description.value: Seaside Pearl Farmgate Winery is a family-owned boutique farmgate winery set among rolling fields and quiet country roads in the Mount Lehman area of Abbotsford, BC. The winery produces small-lot, cool-climate artisanal wines from both estate-grown and Okanagan grapes, with labels named after local pioneer history. Tastings are held in a copper-spired chapel tasting room with panoramic Fraser Valley views, and a separate Barrel Room is available for events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms the winery operates at 5290 Olund Road, Abbotsford, BC with phone 778-856-1312, matching OSM tags. No cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all are marked null. OSM lists postal code V5X 2A3 (a South Vancouver/Marpole code) which is geographically inconsistent with Abbotsford/Mount Lehman — flagged as a concern. OSM also attributes this record to Chilliwack, but the website consistently places the winery in Mount Lehman, Abbotsford.
concerns: OSM postal code V5X 2A3 is a South Vancouver/Marpole code and is geographically inconsistent with the Abbotsford/Mount Lehman location confirmed by the website. Postal code should be corrected.
OSM community field is set to 'Chilliwack', but the winery is located in Mount Lehman, Abbotsford — a different municipality.
OSM opening hours (Fr–Su only) conflict with website hours (Wed–Sun); website hours should be considered more current.
No cycling amenities (bike rack, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned on the website; all required criteria are unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active farmgate winery on quiet rural roads in the Fraser Valley wine region — a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring the area. Amenity details are sparse and should be confirmed on-site, but the destination itself is clearly a good WWC fit.
